source.name: Rinel Foguen Tchuendom, Dena Firoozi, Mich\`ele Breton

items.summary: arXiv:2507.00853v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantilized mean-field game models involve quantiles of the population's distribution. We study a class of such games with a capacity for ranking games, where the performance of each agent is evaluated based on its terminal state relative to the population's $\alpha$-quantile value, $\alpha \in (0,1)$.
